decisions.reason: As a newly launched core-adjacent physical product with a dedicated market presentation, it is likely still within the firm's tolerance band and a large firm has enough slack to give it more time.
Because it is a dedicated, closely related complement to the bulk-container offering, management would usually keep it unless early feedback clearly fell below aspirations, which is not evident here.

The take-back service appears more exploratory and less prominently committed than the hardware products, so its drop risk is higher, but a large German plastics firm is still likely to retain it for now given strategic and customer-facing value.
